defs.def: an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch or dinner 早（或午、晚）餐；一顿饭

ex.s: They cook meals for her.
ex.t: 他们为她做饭。

ex.s: Volunteers will wash, cut, and freeze or dry them for use in meals down the road.
ex.t: 志愿者们会将它们清洗、切块、冷冻或干燥，以便日后用于餐食中。

ex.s: I always assist my parents in doing the dish after meals.
ex.t: 在我看来学生可以从做家务中受益良多。

ex.s: The trend of having meals alone.
ex.t: 独自就餐的趋势。

ex.s: We like cooking at home and make our meals from fresh, seasonal fruit and vegetables.
ex.t: 我们喜欢在家做饭，用新鲜的时令水果和蔬菜来做。

ex.s: I know we should eat more fresh fruit and vegetables, but ready meals are so convenient.
ex.t: 我知道我们应该多吃新鲜水果和蔬菜，但即食食品太方便了。

ex.s: The atmosphere here made the meal all the more enjoyed.
ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 这里的氛围让这顿饭更加令人享受。

ex.s: The young banker who eats lunch at his desk is probably seen as a go-getter, while his colleagues who chat over a relaxed conference-room meal get dirty looks from the corner office.
ex.t: 那个在办公桌前吃午餐的年轻银行家可能被视为有上进心的人，而他在会议室轻松用餐的同事则会从角落办公室投来厌恶的目光。

ex.s: Some were better off than others, but they all needed a good meal and a warm place to eat.
ex.t: 有些人比其他人境况好些，但他们都需要一顿好饭和一个温暖的就餐地方。

ex.s: On the other occasion, they ate a rich morning meal about two hours before they started walking.
ex.t: 然后，在这些男性两次早上访问实验室时，每个人都以平均速度步行一小时，理论上应该让身体主要依靠脂肪作为燃料。

ex.s: Sit and eat his meal.
ex.t: 坐下来吃他的饭。

ex.s: You can plant a tree，make a meal with locally grown vegetables，or save power—the possibilities are endless.
ex.t: 你可以种一棵树、用本地蔬菜做一顿饭，或节约用电——可能性无穷无尽。

ex.s: It’s thanks to these TV chefs rather than any advertising campaign that Britons are turning away from meat-and-two-veg and ready-made meals and becoming more adventurous in their cooking habits.
ex.t: 多亏了这些电视厨师而不是任何广告宣传活动，英国人正在远离“一肉两菜”和即食餐，在烹饪习惯上变得更具冒险精神。

ex.s: I guess I’ve always been a big meat eater and in this house, no family meal is complete without some form of meat.
ex.t: 我想我一直是一个大型肉食者，在这所房子里，没有某种形式的肉类，任何家庭用餐都是不完整的。

ex.s: Don't swallow a meal on the way to work.
ex.t: 别在去上班的路上狼吞虎咽一顿饭。

ex.s: Since it wasn't dark yet after the meal, I decided to walk home from the restaurant.
ex.t: 因为饭后天还没黑，我决定从餐厅走路回家。

ex.s: Knowing some tips will help ensure that you have an enjoyable meal with friends or family — no matter where you are in the world.
ex.t: 了解一些小贴士将有助于确保你与朋友或家人享用一顿愉快的餐食——无论你在世界的哪个角落。

ex.s: It may seem like a simple request to ask for salt and pepper at a meal
ex.t: 用餐时要求加盐和胡椒粉似乎是个简单的请求。

ex.s: Family Alliance Meal Delivery
ex.t: 家庭联盟送餐服务

ex.s: For those who can stomach it, working out before breakfast may be more beneficial for health than eating first, according to a study of meal timing and physical activity.
ex.t: 根据一项关于进餐时间与身体活动的研究，对那些能承受的人来说，早餐前锻炼可能比先吃饭更有益健康。

ex.s: Athletes and scientists have long known that meal timing affects performance.
ex.t: 对于那些能忍受的人来说，根据一项关于进餐时间和体育活动的研究，早餐前锻炼可能比先吃早餐更有益于健康。

ex.s: The unwilling parent organizes the meal schedule, sends out emails, and collects money for end-of-season gifts.
ex.t: 那位不情愿的家长安排用餐时间表、发送电子邮件，并为赛季末礼物筹集资金。

ex.s: Sixteen years  60  (early), Pahlsson had removed the diamond ring  61  (cook) a meal.
ex.t: 十六年____（早）之前，Pahlsson 在____（做）饭时取下了这枚钻石戒指。

ex.s: Since early 2020, Ms Young has raised money to buy meals from Chinatown restaurants and deliver them to those in need.
ex.t: 自2020年初以来，杨女士一直在筹款购买唐人街餐厅的餐食并送给需要帮助的人。

ex.s: And the Good Morning Britain presenter says she’s been able to put a lot of what she’s leant into practice in her own home, preparing meals for sons, Sam, 14, Finn, 13, and Jack, 11.
ex.t: 这位《早安英国》主持人说，她已能把学到的很多东西付诸自家实践，为14岁的萨姆、13岁的芬恩和11岁的杰克三个儿子做饭。

ex.s: However, far less has been known about how meal timing and exercise might affect general health.
ex.t: 然而，关于进餐时间和运动如何影响整体健康，人们所知要少得多。

ex.s: Growing up in San Francisco, Grace Young used to watch her father shop daily in Chinatown for whatever he needed to make traditional Chinese meals at home.
ex.t: 在旧金山长大的格雷丝·杨，常常看着父亲每天在唐人街采购，为他要在家做的传统中餐准备所需的一切。

ex.s: Good Morning Britain’s Susanna Reid is used to grilling guests on the sofa every morning, but she is cooking up a storm in her latest role — showing families how to prepare delicious and nutritious meals on a tight budget.
ex.t: 《早安英国》的苏珊娜·里德习惯每天早上在沙发上盘问嘉宾，但在她最新的角色里，她正大显身手——教家庭如何在预算紧张的情况下准备美味又营养的饭菜。

ex.s: If a student gets hungry on the long drives to and from school, Wilson never   25   to buy them a meal.
ex.t: 如果学生在往返学校的长途车程中饿了，威尔逊从不___25___给他们买顿饭。

defs.def: the food that is eaten at a meal 一餐所吃的食物

ex.s: Curtin is CEO of DC Central Kitchen in Washington, D.C., which recovers food and turns it into healthy meals.
ex.t: Curtin是华盛顿特区DC Central Kitchen的首席执行官，该公司回收食物并将其转化为健康餐食。

ex.s: It makes meals out of unwanted food.
ex.t: 它用不需要的食物制作餐食。

ex.s: A new report found 46 percent of meals are eaten alone in America.
ex.t: 一份新报告发现，美国有46%的餐食是独自吃的。

ex.s: Campers, in my eyes, were people who enjoyed insect bites, ill-cooked meals, and uncomfortable sleeping bags.
ex.t: 在我眼中，露营者是那些喜欢蚊虫叮咬、半生不熟的食物和不舒服睡袋的人。

ex.s: I often end up saving part of my meal for the next day.
ex.t: 我经常把一部分饭菜留到第二天。

ex.s: Nevertheless, it serves as a reminder that there are many ways to address problems of sustainability, and that you can make an amazing meal out of almost anything.
ex.t: 不过，它提醒我们，解决可持续性问题的办法有很多，而且你几乎可以用任何东西做出美味的饭菜。

ex.s: digest the meal easilyB. manage without breakfast
ex.t: 这些结果的启示是，要从运动中获得最大的健康益处，不吃东西可能是明智的选择。

ex.s: To have a meal together.
ex.t: 一起吃饭。
